Class.name: IHC.ITF.Process.Bpl.CernOrdersHl7ToMurjCardioMonitor
Class.Description: iCentra Cardiac Remote Monitor ORM Orders to MURJ

Property.name: HddTargetConfigName
Property.Description: HDD Operation: The target name used for HDD calls

Property.name: NotAllowedLocations
Property.Description: NCIDs for MSH-4 that will be used to filter out the record and not processed it. For example: 525935320 - CERNER - 199 Enterprise Facility used for A31. "999999,99999999" are not real NCIDS values and are used here as place holders that should be replaced when adding real NCID values

Property.name: DoDCOrderHasDischargeDateCheck
Property.Description: Boolean Proptery to determine if MURJ Cardiac ORM Orders will be doing filtering on DCOrderHasDischargeDate.

Property.name: DoNonDefaultNameLookup
Property.Description: Boolean Proptery to determine if MURJ Cardiac ORM Orders will be doing Non-Default Name HDD Conext Lookup. Default is to NOT do additional lookup.
